newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian May industrial growth up 11.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Indian May industrial growth up 11.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: India's industrial production grew 11.5 percent in May over the same month in 1995, Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday.

Chidambaram told a parliamentary committee that the production growth rates in May over the same month in 1995 were 6.8 percent for mining, 13.9 percent for manufacturing and 3.5 percent for electricity generation.
Last month the government announced that its index of industrial production grew 7.7 percent in April over the same month in 1995.

A government statement summarising Chidambaram's comments to the committee quoted the finance minister as saying the government would ensure adequate supply of raw material and credit for the industrial sector.
